description: The actions between the request loop and the application code of office-com-host.ps1 and office-com-session-host.ps1: detect, the read-only preview open, validate, checkpoint, batch (live and background, success and failure, with the workbook and deck checkpoints), rollback, save, render (a second PowerPoint render in one session), post_save_validate, reload_document, replace_presentation_from_source and the DPI repair. The scenarios use the smallest operation of each format so the flows are exercised without the application code; they are recorded again, and the replays extended, once the application tasks land. Not covered: the password-protected legacy files (no, right and wrong password) of the preview, which need documents saved by Office with a password.
